## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet build` has no warnings and `dotnet test` passes
- [ ] New or changed rules have tests (rule fires + calm data does not fire)
- [ ] No new network connections, telemetry or admin requirements (or discussed in an issue first)
- [ ] User-facing text is understandable without technical knowledge
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
